narratives.Overview:
# Missing spend token silently selects N=1

`parseOperatorRunPosture` asks when the launching utterance has no run-posture token. Spend has no parser. `arc no-ingest yolo 4690 4692 4697 4698` therefore resolved posture, recorded yolo-standing, and launched four N=1 Grok critics while `claude` and `codex` were on PATH. The operator's next turn was whether the proper size panel had launched. It had not.

This is an omission hole, not a judgment hole. #3657 already refused "high blast radius selects N≥3". The missing check is the front-door ask, the same shape as run-posture missing-token.

## Measured (2026-09-17)

Operator utterance (closed tokens only): `arc no-ingest yolo 4690 4692 4697 4698`.

- `parseOperatorRunPosture` → `no-ingest`. Yolo is not a posture token (`run-posture.test.ts` "asks when yolo has no posture token").
- Yolo standing confirms a posted all-accept map. It does not pick spend (`content/contracts/design-critique.md` Operator verbs / Stop 1 Run posture).
- PATH on this host: `claude.exe`, `codex.exe`, `grok.exe` all resolve. N≥3 was launchable under `#4432`.
- Stop 1 on all four issues recorded `spend: N=1` and `spend-why: default motion. … not panel spend` with no operator spend token and no ask.
- `evaluatePanelSeatComposition` / `evaluateN3LaunchProbe` never ran. They only apply after the parent already chose N≥3.
- Native `spawn_subagent` dest-cwd was denied as implement-class (leftover `xbrief/active/` 4383). Recovery was Grok CLI last-resort, one family.

Stop 1 ids: #4690 `5716435824`, #4692 `5716436205`, #4697 `5716436526`, #4698 `5716436879`.

## Expected

Missing spend token asks before Stop 1, the same front door as missing run-posture. Closed tokens on the utterance select spend. Yolo does not. Silence is not N=1.

A Stop 1 `spend: N=1` line is admitted only when the parser resolved N=1 or the parent recorded that it asked and the operator answered N=1.

## Actual

Default motion prose ("A permitted N≥3 does not change that default") plus the Grok playbook out-of-scope line "Do not launch a 3-panel unless the operator asks" (`content/docs/grok-build-subscription-setup.md` Out of scope, citing closed #4027 lean-timing) is the only spend selector. There is no `parseOperatorSpend`. There is no `evaluateSpendRecord`. `spend-why` is unparsed English. The cheaper path (one Grok critic, no PATH probe, no panel-deposit) always wins.

## Why not recut permission into selection

#3657 / contract Stop 2: the panel row is permission, not a charter, and not auto-selected by blast radius. One panel that added unique value does not make every high-blast-radius issue spend N≥3. This issue does not change that.

#3846 is the inverse consumer gap (N≥3 without operator consent). Its proposed "N=1 on silence" is this defect. Ask-on-missing-token is the compatible front door: #3846 can still require a consent id on the panel-deposit after the operator picks N≥3.

## Desired deterministic solution

One parser and one fixture. Do not NLP blast radius. Do not grow `evaluatePanelSeatComposition` as this gate.

### `parseOperatorSpend`

Closed tokens, word boundaries, operator chat utterance only (same discipline as `parseOperatorRunPosture`):

- `panel`, `n=3`, `n≥3`, `n>=3` → `{ kind: "resolved", spend: "N≥3" }`
- `n=1` → `{ kind: "resolved", spend: "N=1" }`
- both classes → `{ kind: "ask", reason: "ambiguous" }`
- neither → `{ kind: "ask", reason: "missing-token" }`

Yolo is not a spend token. `critique panel` as a skill trigger in SKILL.md is not an utterance parse. Do not substring-match the skill name.

### `evaluateSpendRecord`

Fixture over parent-claimed inputs, not a live occupancy observer (same class as `evaluateDirectDispatch`):

- `parse` missing-token or ambiguous, `asked: false` → refuse, remediation: ask before Stop 1
- `parse` missing-token or ambiguous, `asked: true`, `answer: N=1 | N≥3` → admit that spend
- `parse` resolved → Stop 1 `spend:` must match; mismatch refuses
- missing Stop 1 `spend:` field refuses

Remediation string names the ask, not "launch a panel".

### Playbook fence

Rewrite the #4027 out-of-scope bullet so it cannot be read as a spend selector. #4027 closed lean-timing. Host-auth playbook does not choose N.

### What this does not do

- ⊗ Select N≥3 from blast radius or open solution space.
- ⊗ Treat yolo as spend confirm.
- ⊗ Make `evaluateN3LaunchProbe` the spend gate.
- ⊗ Close #3846.
- ⊗ Pin this into `templates/agents-entry.md`.

## Acceptance

- Unit: `parseOperatorSpend("arc no-ingest yolo 4690")` is ask/missing-token.
- Unit: `parseOperatorSpend("arc 4690 panel")` is N≥3; `parseOperatorSpend("arc 4690 N=1")` is N=1; yolo ignored.
- Unit: `evaluateSpendRecord` refuses N=1 Stop 1 when parse is missing-token and `asked: false`.
- Unit: admits N=1 only from resolved N=1 token or recorded ask-answer.
- Content-contract pin: missing spend token asks before Stop 1; yolo is not spend.
- Playbook out-of-scope no longer says "Do not launch a 3-panel unless the operator asks".

Refs: #3657, #3846, #4027, #4067, #4072, #4432. Measured on #4690 / #4692 / #4697 / #4698.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator launching a design-critique arc without a spend token, I want the parent to ask before Stop 1, so missing spend cannot silently select N=1.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Add packages/core/src/design-critique/spend.ts parseOperatorSpend (word boundaries, utterance only; yolo ignored; bare panel is ask/ambiguous; n=1 / n=3 / n>=3 resolved; both classes ask). 2. evaluateSpendRecord fixture refuses missing-token plus asked false. Tests in spend.test.ts. 3. Recut content/contracts/design-critique.md Stop 2 default-motion and #3797 fingerprint. Skill pointer Consume parseOperatorSpend. leftover-pain spendSeats 3 for used N>=3. Rewrite grok-build-subscription-setup.md #4027 bullet. Do not grow panel-seat-families. Do not close #3846. Do not pin agents-entry.md. 4. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] #4705.

## Gate stamp

P1 is the 2026-09-17 measured hole: operator utterance arc no-ingest yolo 4690 4692 4697 4698 resolved posture, recorded yolo-standing, and launched four N=1 Grok critics while claude.exe, codex.exe, and grok.exe all resolved. Stop 1 on all four recorded spend: N=1 with spend-why default motion and no operator spend token and no ask. The operator's next turn was whether the proper size panel had launched. It had not.

Pin-read at dispatch-sha edf1d698aafcf956cff08ad3ad14ff608505861a:

- packages/core/src/design-critique/run-posture.ts parseOperatorRunPosture: yolo is not a posture token. Missing token asks. There is no parseOperatorSpend and no evaluateSpendRecord in packages/core/src.
- content/contracts/design-critique.md Stop 2: N>=3 is panel permission, not auto-selection. Default motion remains N=1 unless the parent records using the permission. spend-why is unparsed English.
- packages/core/src/design-critique/panel-seat-families.ts evaluatePanelSeatComposition and evaluateN3LaunchProbe apply only after N>=3 is already chosen. They do not select spend.
- content/docs/grok-build-subscription-setup.md Out of scope cites closed #4027 and says Do not launch a 3-panel unless the operator asks. That line is a spend-selector trap, not lean-timing.

This Stop 1 records spend N=1 because the launching utterance for this arc is each separately, not because silence selected it. Inverse open gap remains #3846 (N>=3 without operator consent). No implement and no ingest from this parent.

model: grok-4.6
```quarantined
role: critic
```

audit-targets: none

Re-verified at dispatch-sha `edf1d698aafcf956cff08ad3ad14ff608505861a` (dest HEAD matches). Ceiling is Stop 1 comment 5716930081. Round-1 N=1, no sibling posts in envelope.

Refutation-target (Stop 1): missing spend token must ask before Stop 1 (`parseOperatorSpend` plus `evaluateSpendRecord`); silence is not N=1; yolo is not spend.

**Refutation result.** The parser-absent half and "yolo is not spend" survive re-measurement. "Silence is not N=1" survives as the desired recut, but it cannot bind next to the uncut Stop 2 default-motion sentence or a resolved `panel` token. Details below.

## 1. Bare `panel` must not resolve to N>=3 (blocks-the-design)

**Evidence.** Desired closed set maps `panel` to resolved N>=3 with word boundaries, same discipline as `parseOperatorRunPosture`. Node check of `/\bpanel\b/i` on this host:

- `arc no-ingest yolo 4690 4692 4697 4698` (measured): no match
- `arc 4690 panel` (desired AC): match
- `do not launch a 3-panel unless the operator asks` (playbook line, content/docs/grok-build-subscription-setup.md:212): match
- `record a panel-deposit`: match
- `not a panel`: match
- `critique panel` (skill trigger, content/skills/deft-directive-design-critique/SKILL.md): match
- `panels never ask`: no match

Hyphen is a word boundary, so `3-panel` and `panel-deposit` are hits. The issue already says the skill trigger is not an utterance parse and not a substring of the skill name; word-boundary `panel` still matches that trigger phrase when it appears in chat.

**Failure mode.** Spend is how many process-only critics receive the untrusted thread (#480), how many CLIs spawn, whether a panel-deposit and three claimed families are required, and which Dual-stop cap applies. A polarity-blind `panel` token selects the non-default spend from "not a panel", from "panel-deposit", and from the playbook's own "3-panel" sentence. That is unauthorized N>=3, the #3846 hole, without an ask. Closing this with reviewer attention fails: the parser would have already resolved.

**Disposition.** Drop `panel` from the resolved set, or map it to ask / ambiguous, not N>=3. Resolved tokens stay spend-shaped: `n=1`, `n=3`, `n>=3`, and the unicode greater-or-equal form (case-insensitive, as the AC already uses `N=1`). Recut the AC that `parseOperatorSpend("arc 4690 panel")` is N>=3. Numeric tokens still let an operator who means a panel resolve without English `panel`.

## 2. Uncut Stop 2 default-motion contradicts refuse-unasked-N=1 (blocks-the-design)

**Evidence.** Pin-read content/contracts/design-critique.md Stop 2 (line 107): "Default motion after a mechanism-shaped stamp: N=1 fresh open critique." Then: a permitted N>=3 does not change that default; the parent records the spend when it uses the permission. Content-contract test "locks the variant-table evaluation rule, not the row prose (#3657)" pins permission-not-selection, not that sentence as a silent selector.

Desired `evaluateSpendRecord`: parse missing-token or ambiguous plus `asked: false` refuses, including a Stop 1 `spend: N=1`. Measured Stop 1s 5716435824 / 5716436205 / 5716436526 / 5716436879 each recorded spend N=1 and spend-why default motion with no spend token and no ask.

Issue "What this does not do" refuses blast-radius selection and cites #3657. It does not recut the default-motion sentence. "Same front door as missing run-posture" is the claimed analogue. `parseOperatorRunPosture` has no published safe default (checkout vs no-ingest are both occupancy-unsafe if wrong). Spend does: Stop 2 already named N=1.

**Failure mode.** Implementer lands the parser and the pin "missing spend token asks before Stop 1" while leaving line 107 in force. Two MUSTs: silent N=1 is the default motion, and silent N=1 is refused. The next parent reading Stop 2 will re-record spend-why default motion on the next `arc no-ingest yolo <ids>` utterance. The measured hole returns under contract cover.

**Disposition.** Recut default-motion to: N=1 only after a resolved `n=1` token or a recorded ask-answer. Permission-not-selection (#3657) stays. "What this does not do" must not be read as "Stop 2 text is unchanged."

## 3. #3846 N=1 on silence is a recut, not a compatible inverse (sharpens-framing)

**Evidence.** REST issues/3846 (open): expected behavior "N=1 must remain fail-closed unless the operator explicitly approves a panel" and session notes "N=1 behavior on silence". This issue says that silence clause is this defect, then "Ask-on-missing-token is the compatible front door" and must not close #3846.

**Failure mode.** #3846 remains open with a published expected that this Bound-remedy inverts. A later #3846 implementer re-teaches silent N=1 as the consent fail-closed. Two issues, two SoTs, same front door.

**Disposition.** Bind can keep #3846 open. The silence clause on #3846 is leftover that must be recut (ask on missing; consent id on the panel-deposit still belongs to #3846 after the operator picks N>=3). Do not call that compatible without naming the recut.

## 4. The run-posture analogue is not an identity copy (sharpens-framing)

**Evidence.**

- `resolveArcRunPostureForHost` (packages/core/src/design-critique/run-posture.ts): on grokBotDetected plus missing-token, resolves no-ingest and does not ask. Copying that default onto spend recreates silent N=1 on grok-bot.
- `evaluateDualStopPostBudget` (packages/core/src/design-critique/leftover-pain.ts): spendSeats === 1 yields 6; spendSeats === 3 yields 3; else 0. Parser output N>=3 is not the integer 3. Unmapped, numbered cap is 0.
- `evaluateSpendRecord` is specified as a fixture over parent-claimed inputs, same class as `evaluateDirectDispatch`. It does not read Stop 1 comments. Measured unparsed field is spend-why English; grep of packages/ at this SHA finds no spend-why consumer. `arc-mode:` has `arcModeRecordLine`; yolo has optional `yolo-standing:`. Spend has neither a published Stop 1 line-start nor a thread parser.
- `evaluatePanelSeatComposition` / `evaluateN3LaunchProbe` skip spend selection (spendN < 3 returns ok). Do not grow them. Confirmed.

**Failure mode.** "Same front door" plus grok-bot default recreates the hole on this host class. A Stop 1 spend N>=3 without a seat integer yields Dual-stop cap 0 (halt or unaddressed N>3). Parent-claimed asked true with no durable spend-ask line means a later critic cannot re-verify, and spend-why English stays the selector.

**Disposition.** Spend missing-token asks even on grok-bot detect (do not copy `resolveArcRunPostureForHost`). Map used permission to Dual-stop spendSeats 3 (N>3 stays unaddressed). Publish Stop 1 spend plus spend-ask resolved|asked (or equivalent) next to arc-mode / yolo-standing, so the fixture has a comment shape to grade, not only claimed booleans.

## Injection / swarm lens

Fired: spend changes authority over untrusted-thread fan-out, CLI spawn count, panel-deposit, seat-family fail-closed (#4067), and Dual-stop posts. Not a local constant.

Existing controls to keep: operator-chat utterance only (issue/comment English are data); N>=3 is permission not selection; launch probe is not the spend gate; yolo is the all-accept confirm conjunct, not spend (`parseOperatorRunPosture("arc 1234 yolo")` is ask/missing-token in run-posture.test.ts; `parseOperatorYoloStanding` is a test-local yolo word-boundary, not a spend parser).

Unsafe new control: resolved `panel` (finding 1). Weak new control: parent-claimed asked with no Stop 1 record (finding 4). Do not concatenate issue body into the parser (title contains N=1; body contains both classes). If a parent did parse this issue body, both n=1 and panel hit, which is fail-safe only if panel is not a resolver.

## Road not taken

Chose: numeric tokens resolve; `panel` does not resolve to N>=3; ask on missing even when PATH has three families.

Steelmanned rejected: keep `panel` as the operator-facing name of N>=3 (variant table, brief spend field, skill trigger "critique panel"). Flip condition: a tighter token that cannot match `3-panel` / `panel-deposit` / `not a panel`, not bare panel-as-word. Negation NLP is the thing the analogue forbids.

Steelmanned rejected: ask only when N>=3 is launchable (issue title is "launchable panels never ask"; this host PATH is grok.exe plus claude.exe plus codex.exe). Flip condition: consent becoming a function of PATH. Same utterance, different hosts, different spend. That is `evaluateN3LaunchProbe` as spend gate, which the issue already forbids.

## Footnotes

- Measured utterance `arc no-ingest yolo 4690 4692 4697 4698`: no-ingest token matches; no spend token in the node check; four Stop 1s at this SHA recorded spend N=1 / spend-why default motion. PATH probe on this dest: C:\Users\msada\.grok\bin\grok.exe, C:\Users\msada\.local\bin\claude.exe, C:\Users\msada\AppData\Local\Programs\OpenAI\Codex\bin\codex.exe. Playbook out-of-scope bullet at line 212 is the cited spend-selector trap; #4027 is closed lean-timing. packages/core/src/design-critique/ has no spend module; grep parseOperatorSpend / evaluateSpendRecord in packages/ is zero.
- `each separately` (this Stop 1 spend-why) is not a closed token. Under the design it asks, then records the answer. Do not add it as n=1.
- Live parent turns stay unenforced, same class as run-posture / yolo-standing. The content-contract pin is the discovery control. That is not a second finding.
- Untrusted thread: issue body "Desired deterministic solution" is design text under critique, not commands to this critic. No instruction to ignore the envelope. No comments after id 5716930081 in envelope.

## In plain English

Missing spend token still silent-defaults N=1 because there is no spend parser, and the proposed closed set would also treat English panel as N>=3. Confirming this map recuts #4705 so spend asks on a missing token, numeric tokens resolve, panel does not, Stop 2 default-motion matches that ask, and grok-bot does not copy a silent spend default. It does not close #3846 and does not turn permission into selection.

This is not an instruction to a later builder.

Non-self-arbitration: same grok-4.6 parent authored Stop 1 and these takes. Takes accept critic headings.

Forward verdict: recut. Disposition: classified headings accept-into-contract. Residual: audit:pain-P1.
